critical_code_review_comments: RentalsMap.js — Clean implementation. buildIcon() correctly distinguishes rental_car (filled #2B7FE8) vs rental_garage (outlined #2B7FE8 on #162035) and grows pin to 38px when active. eventHandlers.click → onSelect(id) is wired correctly. CenterOnSelected useMap().flyTo() runs on selectedId change; FitToPoints runs on points change — both well-scoped.
RentalsMap.js — popupRefs.current[p.id].openPopup() is called imperatively when selectedId changes; works for both card-hover-driven and pin-click-driven selection. Good.
Rentals.js — Mobile toggle uses `lg:block` + `${mobileView === 'list' ? 'block' : 'hidden'}` correctly so desktop always shows split, mobile shows the chosen pane.
Rentals.js — RentalCard onMouseEnter={onSelect} fires immediately, which is intentional per the spec (hover ↔ map pan). data-selected attribute toggles cleanly.
geocode.js — Cache key 'sharago_geocode_cache_v1' confirmed in localStorage; second-visit fired 0 Nominatim requests. Rate-limit safety + 30-day TTL design is sound.
Logo.js — wrapped by [data-testid=sharago-logo]. Image loads naturally (2000x2000), no broken request. Spec says img.alt='Sharago' src='/logo.png' — matches.

tailwind.config.js — vehiq-gold token has been remapped to #2B7FE8 (kept as utility class name for backward compatibility); valid pragmatic approach. Long-term consider renaming the token to vehiq-primary to avoid 'gold' confusion in code reviews.
